meta.name: add-slack
meta.description: Add Slack channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 把 Slack 频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你开发的应用需要 Slack 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need Slack chat in your app

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 加 Slack 频道:拷贝并注册适配器,装固定版依赖,构建并跑测试;再引导建 Slack 应用、填 token、选 Socket 或 webhook、取私聊频道 ID,重启后即可收发 Slack 消息。
howto.when: 当用户要求给 NanoClaw 添加 Slack 频道集成(例如说“接入 Slack”),或正在 /setup 等引导流程中需要接入 Slack 时。

say.text: 我要让 NanoClaw 能收发 Slack 消息。
say.note: 触发 add-slack 技能,进入配置流程。

say.text: 用 Socket 模式接入 Slack,不要公网 URL。
say.note: 选择 Socket 模式并引导填写 App token。

say.text: Slack 事件走 webhook,推给 NanoClaw。
say.note: 选 webhook 并引导填 Signing Secret。

howto.what_en: Add Slack to NanoClaw: copy, register and install the adapter at a pinned version, build and test, then guide through Slack-app setup, socket/webhook choice, token storage, DM-channel resolution and restart; afterwards Claude can use Slack.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add Slack to NanoClaw, or is in a /setup or channel-wiring flow that needs Slack.

say_en.text: I want NanoClaw to talk with me over Slack.
Connect Slack in Socket Mode — no public URL.
Deliver Slack events to NanoClaw via webhook.
say_en.note: Chooses webhook delivery and guides the signing secret.
